name: How long does it take to install an interior door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an interior door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a standard interior pre-hung door frame typically takes two to four hours for a skilled carpenter. If the project involves custom framing, structural adjustments to the rough opening, or extensive drywall patching and trim matching, the work can extend to a full day. In basement remodels or room additions, framing out multiple openings is often coordinated alongside wall framing and drywall hanging. Ensuring the frame is perfectly plumb, level, and square takes precise shimming, especially in older homes where existing studs may have shifted or bowed over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing a standard pre-hung door frame usually takes two to four hours. Custom rough framing or extensive drywall and trim repairs can extend the work to a full day.
